name: AI Viral Video Prompts

source: Read from the live site's stylesheet (styles.css)

colours.name: Coral
colours.role: Accent one: start of the gradient, key words

colours.name: Teal

voice: Energetic, creative, results-focused. Show, don't tell: practical prompts and examples over theory.
imagery: Stills and clips from real AI video output; this is the natural home for showing the tools off.
When people appear, show a mix of nationalities and ethnicities; never one default face.
Use the coral-to-teal gradient for one headline word or a border, not whole backgrounds.
logo: No logo file was found in the site's code. Add one to Drive under 99 Brand Assets.
doNot: Do not use coral or teal for body text on white: both are too faint.
